description.value: Saigon Char-Broil is a Vietnamese restaurant chain with three Victoria-area locations; the Esquimalt outpost sits at the corner of Esquimalt Road and Fraser Street and offers both dine-in and takeout. The menu centres on phở, char-broiled vermicelli bowls, salad rolls, and bánh mì-style subs, with tofu and vegetable substitutions available across most dishes. It is a standalone street-front restaurant — unlike the chain's other two mall food-court locations — making it an accessible refuelling stop for cyclists moving through the Esquimalt corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (1 space) at 26m. Total: 1 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Esquimalt location at 1205 Esquimalt Rd with phone 250-590-9232, matching OSM data; the city listed on the website is 'Victoria, BC' rather than OSM's 'Esquimalt', which are distinct municipalities. Takeout is explicitly promoted ('Order Takeout in 3 easy steps', dedicated Take Out Menu) and tofu/veggie substitutions appear across virtually every menu category, confirming vegetarian options. No website or OSM content addresses bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: Website lists the address city as 'Victoria, BC' while OSM records 'Esquimalt' — Esquimalt is a separate municipality, though the street address (1205 Esquimalt Rd) and postal code (V9A 3P1) match exactly.
Website branding omits 'Restaurant' from the business name ('Saigon Char-Broil') versus the OSM name 'Saigon Char-Broil Restaurant'.
This is one of three chain locations; the Hillside and Tillicum locations are in mall food courts and may have separate OSM records that should be reviewed for deduplication.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established Vietnamese restaurant with confirmed dine-in and takeout on a main cycling corridor in Esquimalt; the broad vegetarian-friendly menu and street-front location make it a practical stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Tofu & Veggie substitutions offered across salads, salad rolls, spring rolls, sub sandwiches, vermicelli bowls, rice dishes, and soups on the Esquimalt menu; vegetarian spring rolls explicitly noted
